description: Primary image archive endpoints per space agency. Consumed by the agency-first resolver in scripts/lib/agency-resolver.mjs. Locked by ADR-046; codified 2026-06-17 after the inventory revealed batch fetchers going straight to Commons. See scripts/IMAGE-PIPELINE.md §'Source-resolution order'.

NASA / JPL.label: NASA Jet Propulsion Laboratory
NASA / JPL.notes: JPL Photojournal hosts higher-res masters of PIA images. Resolver tries NASA images-api first (covers JPL); use this tier only when image-api returns crops.

JAXA.label: Japan Aerospace Exploration Agency
JAXA.license_default: JAXA Press Use (free for editorial; attribute to JAXA)
JAXA.notes: JAXA has no public image search API. Resolver tries to scrape the configured gallery page with selector hints; falls back to the curated URL list keyed by mission_id.

ESA.label: European Space Agency
ESA.notes: ESA Multimedia hosts mission sets; resolver targets the set page and extracts src attributes. Falls back to curated URL list.

JHU-APL.label: Johns Hopkins Applied Physics Laboratory
JHU-APL.license_default: Public Domain (JHU APL on NASA mission)
JHU-APL.notes: JHU APL is prime contractor on DART / Parker / New Horizons / Dragonfly. Their galleries are higher-res than NASA archive mirrors for hardware shots + the canonical 'DART final frame'. Site has been slow / timed out — curated fallback is load-bearing.

ASI.label: Italian Space Agency / Agenzia Spaziale Italiana
ASI.notes: Italian agency, partner on DART (LICIACube imaged the impact). No public search API; curated URLs only.

CNSA.label: China National Space Administration
CNSA.notes: Chinese space program imagery is press-release based. Direct hot-linking unstable; curated mirrors via Xinhua / state-media press releases.

Roscosmos.label: Roscosmos State Corporation
Roscosmos.notes: Roscosmos site has been intermittently dark since 2022. Curated picks are the durable path.

ISRO.label: Indian Space Research Organisation
ISRO.notes: ISRO publishes mission imagery via press releases. Curated picks per mission.

WIKIMEDIA_COMMONS_FAILOVER.label: Wikimedia Commons (failover only)
WIKIMEDIA_COMMONS_FAILOVER.credit_default: agency original via Wikimedia Commons mirror
WIKIMEDIA_COMMONS_FAILOVER.notes: Tier 7 — only consulted when all agency tiers miss. Resolver MUST attempt agency tiers first; PR reviewers reject Commons-first additions per IMAGE-PIPELINE.md REGRESSION GUARD.
